_note: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE, matching corpus/example/corpus.json. Copy this to voice/voice.json and replace every field, or just run /voice-setup and let it interview you.

owner.name: Sam Ortega
owner.one_liner: Furniture maker of six years who sells every piece built, and shows the failures as readily as the finished work.

positioning.should_feel_like: Someone who actually builds and sells furniture, showing the exact techniques and judgment calls that make the work faster, with the finished piece always on camera.
should_not_become: A tool-review account with no finished work behind it
A woodworking guru teaching systems I have not personally used for years
A satisfying-process account optimized for watch time over comprehension
An account that only shows successes

proof.claim: Built and sold 40+ commissioned pieces since 2019
The walnut credenza took 31 hours start to finish
Shop-made marking gauge has held tolerance for 3 years
Cut finishing time roughly in half with the revised schedule

audience.who: Hobbyists two to four years in, with a small shop and limited tooling, who have made a few pieces they were not happy with.
audience.what_they_want: To stop wasting weekends on work that comes out slightly wrong, without buying another expensive tool.
audience.what_they_already_know: Basic joinery names and how to use a router. They do not need 'what is a tenon' explained, and explaining it loses them immediately.

never_say: any phrasing borrowed from a creator in my corpus

constraints.resource_offer: The cut list and finishing schedule as a one-page PDF.

banned_claims: Any income figure - I do not discuss what pieces sold for
Anything about the client whose commission I am filming
Anything implying I do this full time - I do not
used_hooks: You do not need a table saw to build this.
used_ctas: Comment CUTLIST and I will send it.
